keyFindings: Website14day request and14day sample list belong to Open-Meteo, not native WeatherKit.
Native daily list caps returned entries at10; does not guarantee full10days at every location/request. Hourly coverage is separately returned.
Native current-location permission and selected-place search are distinct. Calendar display uses shared selected weather, not proven automatic geocoding of every event venue.
Destination forecast does not change GPS-based weather-alert location.
Initial demo samples not labelled until failure; location name can coexist with fallback sample weather.
Homepage English tabs/range/metric captions remain partially hardcoded across locale pages.

evidence.finding: Open-Meteo city search and browser forecast requests, selected coordinates/timezone,10min cache,forecast_days14. No browser GPS request in inspected service; US units inferred from selected country.
Initial snapshot null/offline false; fallback hourly/daily14rows; daily tab literal14days. Network failure sets offline; no snapshot selects samples.
Source attribution only with snapshot; sample label only on offline. Initial/prerender/loading sample state lacks sample label. English tab labels shared across locales.

Apple WeatherService coordinate query for current/hourly/daily/alerts; all returned hourly mapped, daily cap min(count,10); error path supplies failure message. Debug query override excluded from release claims.
Current-location and selected saved/searched region paths; searches use placemark coordinates and timezone. Manual destination fetch distinct from device location.
Requests when-in-use permission; starts GPS only authorized, stops denied/restricted.
MapKit place completion filters likely street addresses with numeric characters, resolves coordinates/timezone. Do not promise postcode always works/better precision.
Calendar strip uses shared selected weather hourly data filtered by date; does not derive new coordinates from every event location in this path.
Weather alerts depend on app preference, OS permission and stored real GPS location with age gate; selected destination not equivalent to alert location.
Forecast event draft uses selected forecast timezone, chosen hour,1h default duration, system default calendar; creation permission path separate from weather.
